```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(emmeans)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(car)
library(agricolae)
library(patchwork)
```

# Read in Data

```{r}
d <- read.csv('Data/Biomass.csv') 
d$Condition <- gsub(' ','',d$Condition)
d$Fertilization <- gsub('FF','Fertilized_Fertilized',d$Fertilization)
d$Fertilization <- gsub('UF','Unfertilized_Fertilized',d$Fertilization)
d$Fertilization <- gsub('FU','Fertilized_Unfertilized',d$Fertilization)
d$Fertilization <- gsub('UU','Unfertilized_Unfertilized',d$Fertilization)

d <- d %>%
mutate(Condition = as_factor(Condition)) %>%
mutate(Condition = fct_relevel(Condition, "No_Plant", "Wild", "Modern"))
table(d$Condition)
d <- d %>%
mutate(Fertilization = as_factor(Fertilization)) %>%
mutate(Fertilization = fct_relevel(Fertilization, "Unfertilized_Unfertilized","Unfertilized_Fertilized",  "Fertilized_Unfertilized",  "Fertilized_Fertilized"))
table(d$Fertilization)

d.s <- filter(d, Sterility == "Sterile")

d.sfp <- filter(d.s, Fertilization != "Unfertilized_Unfertilized") %>% 
  filter(., Fertilization != "Unfertilized_Fertilized")

s.shoot <- filter(d.s, Type=='Shoot')
s.root <- filter(d.s, Type == 'Root')
par(mfrow=c(2,2))
```

# Shoot Biomass


```{r}
mod <- lm(Biomass_g ~ Fertilization*Condition, data = s.shoot)
plot(mod)
Anova(mod, type = 3)
emmip(mod, Condition ~ Fertilization, CIs = TRUE, type = "response")# type = response shows backtransformed 
t <- HSD.test(mod, "Condition");t
emmeans(mod, pairwise ~ Condition|Fertilization)

emmeans(mod, ~ Condition*Fertilization, type = "response")
df <- as.data.frame(emmeans(mod, ~ Condition*Fertilization, type = "response"))

res <- emmeans(mod, list(pairwise ~ Condition*Fertilization), adjust = "fdr")
plot(res[[1]], horizontal=T)
groups <- data.frame(multcomp::cld(res[[1]], adjust='fdr', Letters=c("abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxy"), decreasing=T)) %>% 
  select(., Fertilization, Condition, .group)
df <- inner_join(df,groups, by = c('Fertilization', 'Condition'))

names(df)[names(df) == '.group'] <- 'letters'
df$letters <- gsub(' ','',df$letters)
```


```{r}
df.f <- filter(df, Fertilization == "Fertilized_Fertilized" |  Fertilization == "Fertilized_Unfertilized")
df.u <- filter(df, Fertilization == "Unfertilized_Fertilized" |  Fertilization == "Unfertilized_Unfertilized")

p_shoot_f <- ggplot(aes(x=Fertilization, y=emmean, fill = Condition), data = df.f) +
  geom_col(position = 'dodge') +
  geom_errorbar(position = position_dodge(0.9),width=0.25,alpha=0.5,
                aes(ymin = emmean-SE, ymax = emmean+SE))+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c('yellow3','darkorange2','darkblue'))+
  geom_text(aes(label = letters),position=position_dodge(0.9), vjust = -1, hjust = 0) +
  theme_classic()+
  labs(y="Shoot Biomass (g)")+
  theme(legend.title = element_blank(),
        legend.position = 'right',
        axis.text = element_text(color='black'),
       # axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.title.x = element_blank());p_shoot_f
```

### Root
## Model
```{r}
mod <- lm((Biomass_g) ~ Fertilization*Condition, data = s.root)
plot(mod)
Anova(mod, type = 3)
emmip(mod, Condition ~  Fertilization, CIs = TRUE, type = "response")# type = response shows backtransformed 
t <- HSD.test(mod, "Condition");t
emmeans(mod, pairwise ~ Condition|Fertilization)

emmeans(mod, ~ Condition*Fertilization, type = "response")
df <- as.data.frame(emmeans(mod, ~ Condition*Fertilization, type = "response"))

res <- emmeans(mod, list(pairwise ~ Condition*Fertilization), adjust = "fdr")
plot(res[[1]], horizontal=T)
groups <- data.frame(multcomp::cld(res[[1]], adjust='fdr', Letters=c("abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxy"), decreasing=T)) %>% 
  select(., Fertilization, Condition, .group)
df <- inner_join(df,groups, by = c('Fertilization', 'Condition'))

names(df)[names(df) == '.group'] <- 'letters'
df$letters <- gsub(' ','',df$letters)
```

```{r}
df.f <- filter(df, Fertilization == "Fertilized_Fertilized" |  Fertilization == "Fertilized_Unfertilized")
df.u <- filter(df, Fertilization == "Unfertilized_Fertilized" |  Fertilization == "Unfertilized_Unfertilized")

p_root_f<- ggplot(aes(x=Fertilization, y=response, fill = Condition), data = df.f) +
  geom_col(position = 'dodge') +
  geom_errorbar(position = position_dodge(0.9),width=0.25,alpha=0.5,
                aes(ymin = response-SE, ymax = response+SE))+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c('yellow3','darkorange2','darkblue'))+
  geom_text(aes(label = letters),position=position_dodge(0.9), vjust = -1, hjust = 0) +
  theme_classic()+
  labs(y="Root Biomass (g)")+
  theme(legend.title = element_blank(),
        legend.position = 'right',
        axis.text = element_text(color='black'),
        axis.title.x = element_blank());p_root_f
```
